headline: The two big red days were NOT market-wide — both were the known single-name-reversal/down-capture failure mode plus one quote-artifact option stop: Aug 18's -$26,844 was ~89% unrealized marks across 13 held names on a mere -0.68% SPY day (book -2.63%, ~3.9x down-capture; biggest hits IESC -$6.7k, CDE -$4.8k, NVDA -$3.8k, QQQ core -$2.8k), and Aug 20's -$11,970 (1.4x SPY's -0.84%) had 30% of it from an HL bull-call-spread premium stop that executed at -67.6% vs its -50% width 14 seconds after the open while the underlying was UP; per-name defenses fired and saved ~$18k+ (KALU/AEHR expectancy-gate rejects into -13%/-15% days), but every index-level defense — core trim, PSQ auto-hedge, index puts, and the new IWM put proxy — executed exactly zero trades.
evidence: Q1/Aug18: day_pl -26,843.77 (equity_history.jsonl) but realized was only -3,027 (INTC -2,085, MTRN -1,286, F -842, ONDS -9, IESC +1,194); ~-23.8k was open-position marks. Close-to-close attribution: IESC -6,693 (prior close ~793 -> exit 735.12 after being held all morning at 'falling -7.3% today'), CDE -4,799 (5,999sh, 19.31->18.51), NVDA -3,805 (722sh -2.34%), QQQ core -2,782 (225sh -1.69%), INTC -2,269, MTRN -1,988, SOFI -1,130, NOK -946, AMZN -541, SPCX -405; residual ~-1.3k option-leg marks.

Q2/Aug18 was single-name, not market: log 'Market regime: SPY above 200dma (769 vs 703, today -1.0%)... risk-on, size x1.00' — SPY closed -0.68%, QQQ -1.69%, IWM -1.26% while held/slate momentum names cracked: MTRN -8.26%, INTC -6.57%, IESC -7.3% intraday, KEEL -16.2%, KALU -13.1%, AEHR -15.4%. Book -2.63% = ~3.9x SPY down-capture, worse than the 2.22 that failed the window bar.

Q1/Aug20: day_pl -11,970 despite POSITIVE realized +3,408 (CDE +7,615 bracket_take at exactly +25% TP, IBIT +1,259, HL option -3,650, SPCX -1,817). Marks: AMZN -1,667, QQQ -1,159, SOFI -870, NU -840, SMCI(new 801sh @37.47) -777, F(new) -305, NVDA -513, plus est -1.5-2.5k decay on 63 long PFE calls (stock -1.59%). SPY -0.84%, book -1.18% = 1.4x down-capture.

Q4/HL smoking gun: 'watchdog | Option exit on HL 2026-09-18: premium stop -50% (now -67.6%). Closing 2 leg(s)' at 08:30:14 — 14 seconds into the first post-open cycle. Entry 1.04 debit Aug 19 17:03Z; underlying HL rose +14.4% Aug 19 and traded UP Aug 20 (20.24-21.18 vs 20.54 close) — a bull call spread cannot legitimately lose 67.6% while the underlying rises; this is the Jul 23 junk one-sided-quote failure mode on open-auction option marks, executed 17.6pp past the stop width. -$3,650 = 30% of Aug 20's loss.

Q3/NAME FALLING (NAME_DROP_DEFENSE_PCT=4.0) fired 11 reads Aug 18: 'NAME FALLING: INTC -4.5% today vs SPY -1.0% — defense read armed (loss-cut release + HELD-line note)' (also NOK, ONDS, MTRN, IESC x4) -> exits ONDS/INTC/MTRN/IESC; Aug 20: 2 reads (F -4.6%, SPCX -4.7%) -> SPCX exit. Rotation guard released cuts: 'Rotation guard: PASS INTC at -6.2% — red book day (day P/L -2.00%): a requested loss-cut is defense, not churn.'

Q3/Index-level defenses ALL silent: core defense never fired (risk_state core_defense_day=''; every cycle logged only 'Core fill skipped: QQQ already at/above the 15% ceiling'), PSQ auto-hedge 'auto_hedge=flat' every cycle, put_approved=0 all three days — they key on an index falling read and SPY never fell past -1.1% intraday, so the QQQ core bled -2.8k/-1.2k untouched. Aug 18 (worst day of cycle): 'BEARISH FUNNEL: slate_bearish=1 [RCON -0.52 gate-blocked] put_proposals=0 put_approved=0 auto_hedge=flat proxy_put=none'.

Q3/PR#53 IWM proxy put fired ONCE (Aug 19 12:54): 'PROXY PUT: MARA put blocked on liquidity -> proposing IWM 301.0/285.0 2026-09-25' then 'REJECT buy IWM: Leg IWM260925P00301000 open interest 55 < 100 floor — too illiquid to exit cleanly.' Net bearish trades for the whole window: zero. (Silver lining: MARA then rose +7.7%/+15.5%, so the puts would have lost.)

Q5/Risk blocks that HELPED (huge): Aug 18 09:25 'Cycle budget $233,994 split across 2 buy(s): KALU $140,396, MRAAY $91,332' -> KALU rejected by expectancy gate ('every cited thesis family is negative... composite -12.0%/trip x11'); KALU fell -13.08% THAT DAY (save ~$15-18k). AEHR rejected same gate, -15.36% same day. ARGX rejected by gap gate ('Overextended: +16% above the prior close (gap-day chase; 4.2xATR)'). Aug 19 loss-streak bar: 'REJECT buy INTC: lost its last 2 closed trip(s) — needs composite >= +1.25 (+1.06)'; INTC -4.0% that day. Aug 20: CDE top-up rejected at RSI 69/3.5xATR before CDE faded -0.66%.

Q5/Blocks that COST: Aug 18 11:09 'REJECT buy CDE: Top-up conviction 0.66 shows no new edge over prior entry 0.63 (needs +0.05)' — CDE +13.07% next day, a $50-90k top-up would have made $7-12k. Claude-side misses: HELD NOK through two armed NAME FALLING reads ('7.4pp of stop room remains') — NOK -3.62% Aug 18 (-$946) and kept sliding; zero put proposals on the worst day.

Q4/Stop-trail latency: INTC entry 102.98 -> HW 105.97 (+2.9%, 5% trail-arm never reached) -> exit 96.97: -8.5% give-back from HW; read armed 08:33 at -4.5% but exit came NEXT cycle 09:25 at -5.8% (52min, -1.3pp cadence cost). MTRN entry 277.15 -> HW 290.00 (+4.6%, trail unarmed) -> exit 265.71: -8.4% from HW, -7.7% of it in one morning between cycles. SPCX entry 146.315 bled -2.0%/-2.6% on Aug 18/19 (each UNDER the 4% read bar) then exited -8.9% Aug 20 — death by sub-threshold drips. All cuts landed 0.7-4.2pp before hard stops; the leak is hourly cadence + the 4% per-day read floor, not stop width (except HL).

Ops bug both days: decision SELLs initially FAILED on bracket replace — 'replace sell ... failed ({"code":42210000,"message":"take_profit.limit_price must be > stop_loss.stop_price"}); falling back to cancel' -> 'SELL F approved but the close FAILED — queued for the watchdog' (Aug 18) and identical for SPCX (Aug 20); CRITICAL emails sent, watchdog recovered within ~15-25min, cost immaterial but it's a repeating replace-parameter bug.

Q6/Aug 19's +19,336 (zero closes, pure marks) was the SAME kept book bouncing: CDE +14,518 (75% of the day, 5,999sh 18.51->20.93 +13.07%), MLAB +2,203 (+10.91%), AMZN +1,860, SOFI +1,322, offset by NVDA -1,574/NWFL -690/NOK -631/SPCX -836. So Aug 18's markdown on KEPT names was mostly noise — but the Aug 18 CUTS kept falling after exit (INTC -4.0% Aug 19, MTRN -7.1%, IESC 735 exit -> 685 by Aug 21), validating those exits. Exception: F bounced +4.09% and was re-bought Aug 20 at 14.165 vs the 13.925 exit — a ~$425 churn round-trip.
surprises: The nightly postmortem called IESC 'the winner +$1,194' on Aug 18 — but IESC was the day's SINGLE BIGGEST hit (-$6.7k day-attributed, held from -6.0% to -7.3% across four NAME FALLING reads before exiting). The postmortem measures realized P&L from entry basis and is blind to give-back, so it drew a lesson from the wrong name; expect systematically mislabeled 'winners' on any day a long-held gainer round-trips.

The HL premium stop executed at -67.6% vs its -50% width 14 seconds after the open while the underlying was UP ~1-4% — the Jul 23 'junk one-sided quote' failure mode resurfacing on exit marks in the open auction. PR #40 hardened entry pricing; watchdog premium-stop marks in the first minute after open are unhardened and just cost $3,650 (30% of Aug 20).

PR #53's headline feature (IWM put proxy) fired exactly once in the entire away window and was killed by its own OI liquidity floor (55 < 100) — combined with core defense never arming (SPY never fell past -1.1%) and auto_hedge staying flat, the bearish sleeve remains structurally at ZERO trades while the book runs ~3.9x down-capture on calm-tape red days.

The expectancy gate silently saved roughly the whole Aug 18 realized loss several times over: it rejected a $140,396 KALU buy proposed at 09:25 into what became a -13.1% day for KALU, and an AEHR buy into a -15.4% day. Without it Aug 18 would plausibly have been a -$45k+ day and the window's away-mode story very different.

Robinhood screener credentials lapsed mid-window: Aug 20 log shows 'robinhood screener disabled (no credentials); skipping' (Aug 18 still had RH movers) — the RH discovery leg silently died while the user was away; the self-heal kept the bot alive but not its data feeds.

CDE concentration drove the whole 3-day P&L arc: a $112k double-lot (5,999 sh) in one silver miner swung -$4.8k / +$14.5k / +$1.8k on Aug 18/19/20 and was 75% of the Aug 19 'recovery', while the bot simultaneously added an HL (also silver) options position Aug 19 — the sector bet, not stock-picking, made Aug 18 look like noise and Aug 19 look like skill.
